cottage_a.notes: a one-room tiled stone cottage; the commonest building anywhere

cottage_b.notes: a tiled cottage with a lean-to

townhouse_a.notes: a two-storey tiled house with a crow-stepped street gable; only from a town upward

townhouse_b.notes: a tiled house with a jettied upper floor and an outside stair

workshop.notes: a workshop with an open front

barn.notes: the outlying kind: barns and byres sit in the thinning ring

church.notes: a town's and a fort's centre; min_group is fort, not town, because a fort ranks BELOW a town and the landmark is now the highest its group allows (2026-09-22)

church_b.notes: a VARIANT of church (owner 2026-09-30: every Tripo version kept for variety): the same rank; bake_houses._pick_landmark picks one per settlement by weight

church_tower.notes: a city's centre: the tower is the silhouette that reads at 9 px

palace_b.notes: a VARIANT of palace (owner 2026-09-30): the same rank, picked per capital by weight

palace_c.notes: a VARIANT of palace (owner 2026-09-30): the same rank, picked per capital by weight

wall.notes: a town wall's module (owner 2026-10-01: 城镇的外围能增加城墙): exactly footprint_m long, its ends flat; bake_houses.fortify lays them round a walled settlement, front (-Y in Blender) to the field

wall_tower.notes: a round tower on the wall's line, at its corners, every few modules and where a wall stops at the water

wall_gate.notes: a gatehouse where a road crosses the wall's line, its passage on the road

pier.notes: a port's timber pier (owner 2026-10-01: 码头延伸到海里): bake_houses.harbour runs it out from the shore; the runtime seats its deck at the sea (role pier)

pier_cliff.notes: a cliff harbour (owner 2026-10-01: 适合那种我的首都建在悬崖边上的那种风格): its own rock with a zigzag stair to a castle on top and a timber quay at its foot; bake_houses.harbour stands it where a port's shore is a cliff, its rock to the land (-X) and its quay out to sea, the deck at the sea like a pier

pier_stair.notes: a cliff-top town's landing (owner 2026-10-05: 建在崖顶的小城…配一个更小的崖边码头): a jetty at the foot of its own rock and a two-flight stair up it to a gate on top; bake_houses.harbour stands it where the cliff is its own height

fishing_boat.notes: a port's moored ship (owner 2026-10-04: 港口城市停留在港口的船舶装饰 … 根据大小1-2艘): bake_houses.harbour moors one or two beside its pier by the settlement's rank (map3d_bake.csv ship_*); drawn a quarter under the houses' twice-life scale so a ship never outweighs its town (critic 2026-10-04); the runtime floats its origin, the waterline, on the sea and rocks it on the swell (house_surface.gdshader bob); the smallest, any port

cog.notes: a merchant cog, from a town's port upward

longship.notes: an oared longship, from a town's port upward

carrack.notes: a three-masted carrack, only at a city's or a capital's port
